description: This file defines the ViewConvertLead class, a PHP class for handling Lead Conversion UI and logic within the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for displaying the conversion form, saving new or related records, copying address and activity data, and managing relationships between lead, contact, account, and other modules.

classes.name: ViewConvertLead
classes.description: A PHP class extending SugarView to handle Lead Conversion interface and process, including UI rendering, record creation, relationship management, and activity copying in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ViewConvertLead class, setting metadata filename.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Checks for edit permissions before displaying the view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to render the lead conversion form, handle saving, and populate related data.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description: Retrieves the lead record based on request parameters.

methods.name: loadDefs
methods.description: Loads view definitions from metadata files.

methods.name: getValidationJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript validation for the conversion form based on view definitions.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes form submission to create or relate beans (Contacts, Accounts, etc.) during lead conversion.

methods.name: setMeetingsUsersRelationship
methods.description: Adds the current user to the related meetings during conversion.

methods.name: displaySaveResults
methods.description: Outputs the result of save operations, listing created or existing beans.

methods.name: handleActivities
methods.description: Copies or moves activities from lead to related beans based on user selection.

methods.name: moveActivity
methods.description: Reassigns an activity to a new parent bean.

methods.name: getActivitiesFromLead
methods.description: Fetches activities linked to the lead record.

methods.name: copyActivityAndRelateToBean
methods.description: Duplicates an activity and relates it to a specified bean.

methods.name: populateNewBean
methods.description: Populates a new bean’s fields from lead or contact data.

methods.name: copyAddressFields
methods.description: Copies address fields from contact to other beans if not set.

methods.name: findRelationship
methods.description: Finds the relationship name between two beans.

methods.name: findRelationshipByName
methods.description: Finds a relationship by its name on a bean.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates breadcrumb parameters for the module title display.

methods.name: checkForDuplicates
methods.description: Warns if the lead has already been converted and shows duplicate contacts.
